entries.title: Psalms 26:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Judge me, O Jehovah, for I have walked in mine integrity, and I have confided in Jehovah: I shall not slip.

entries.title: Psalms 26:2
segments: Prove me, Jehovah, and test me; try my reins and my heart:

entries.title: Psalms 26:3
segments: For thy loving-kindness is before mine eyes, and I have walked in thy truth.

entries.title: Psalms 26:4
segments: I have not sat with vain persons, neither have I gone in with dissemblers;

entries.title: Psalms 26:5
segments: I have hated the congregation of evil-doers, and I have not sat with the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 26:6
segments: ¶I will wash my hands in innocency, and will encompass thine altar, O Jehovah,

entries.title: Psalms 26:7
segments: That I may cause the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, and declare all thy marvellous works.

entries.title: Psalms 26:8
segments: Jehovah, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thy glory dwelleth.

entries.title: Psalms 26:9
segments: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with men of blood;

entries.title: Psalms 26:10
segments: In whose hands are evil devices, and their right hand is full of bribes.

entries.title: Psalms 26:11
segments: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity. Redeem me, and be gracious unto me.

entries.title: Psalms 26:12
segments: My foot standeth in an even place; in the congregations will I bless Jehovah.
